parole.significato: box with golden gifts of the Philistines
parole.testo: Probably borrowed from Philistine. Compare Aramaic אַרְגָּזְתָּא, Classical Syriac ܪܓܙܬܐ, Arabic رِجَازَة (rijāza).

parole.significato: lord, prince, ruler of one of the five Philistine cities
parole.testo: Borrowed from Philistine, F. M. Cross suggests 𐤈𐤓𐤍 (ṭrn), which he translates as "tyrant". R. D.
